messages:
sara-cs: FYI receiving an urgent escalation from ACME (enterprise) — they say the March invoice shows ~4,520,312 tokens but their dashboard and exports show ~2,087,941. Customer wants refund + root cause. They attached their billing CSV and a sample API key that triggered the spike.

billing-bot: Got it — ticket created: TKT-45821. Initial alert sent to billing queue. :receipt:

maria-support: Thanks. Can you paste the CSV rows (redacted) they attached and the API key prefix? I want to correlate with server logs.

sara-cs: Pasting sanitized rows from customer export below (they redacted full key):
```
date,api_key_prefix,request_count,token_count
2026-03-04,sk_live_abc...,412,2123450
2026-03-05,sk_live_abc...,1020,2396862
2026-03-06,sk_live_abc...,8,297000
```
Customer says dashboard UI shows only 2,087,941 total for month.

dave-engineer: Quick thought — do we double-count streaming tokens when requests include function-calls + multiple choice outputs? Also need to check ingestion pipeline that aggregates per-request tokens into billing buckets.

maria-support: Repro steps requested by ops/eng: can someone grep for that key prefix in logs and paste a compact sample of request/response headers and any retry attempts?

jordan-ops: I pulled logs. Found a pattern where client got intermittent 401s and retried with backoff, then succeeded — but our metering pipeline processed both the failed and final request counts for that API key because the auth layer emitted token metrics before the auth check completed. Sample snippet: 
```
[2026-03-05T11:04:12Z] key=sk_live_abc... attempt=1 status=401 tokens_reported=1023
[2026-03-05T11:04:13Z] key=sk_live_abc... attempt=2 status=200 tokens_reported=1023
```
This would add ~2x tokens for retried requests. :thinking_face:

dave-engineer: That log pattern aligns with a known race introduced in the streaming PR last quarter where pre-auth token accounting was emitted on connection start. I flagged a unit in the accounting service where we call emitTokenUsage() on socket connect instead of after auth.

maria-support: Ok — if that’s true, the customer’s 2.1M dashboard would reflect corrected accounting (we started backfilling later), but invoices pulled from raw meter feed included the duplicate early counts.

kevin-finance: Requested refund calculation: can we estimate the overcount and propose credit? If invoice shows 4,520,312 but true usage ~2,087,941 then overcharged tokens = 2,432,371. What pricing tier applies for ACME (enterprise discounted rate)? @sara-cs please confirm contract rate.

sara-cs: ACME on Enterprise Silver — rate is $0.00012 per token for generated tokens (per contract). They’ve asked for full refund of the overage.

jordan-ops: I can produce a corrected meter file for the invoice period after we dedupe retries. Will also tag each corrected line with revrec_note: "deduped-retry-accounting-bug-2026-03" so finance can apply a credit.

kevin-finance: Good. For the ledger we need: (1) corrected usage CSV, (2) a short revrec memo for revenue recognition rollback, and (3) approval from Support/CS that this is customer-impacting bug. I’ll draft the credit memo once we have numbers.

maria-support: I ran a quick dedupe script (heuristic: group by key + timestamp bucket + identical token_reported) and it reduces reported tokens for that key from 4,520,312 to 2,094,128 in our sample window. Script snippet: 
```
# dedupe by (api_key_prefix, request_ts_floor, tokens_reported)
def dedupe(rows):
  out = {}
  for r in rows:
    key=(r['api_key_prefix'], r['ts']//2, r['tokens_reported'])
    out.setdefault(key,0)
    out[key] += 1
  return compute_token_sums(out)
```
This gives an estimated overcount ~2,426,184 (close to Sara's number).

dave-engineer: We should still verify across the entire invoice period, not just sample. I’ll run dedupe across the raw meter topic (kafka partition 12) and produce a corrected CSV. ETA ~90 minutes.

sara-cs: Please cc me when done — we need to update ACME's case and propose credit. Customer is sensitive because they budgeted for the month.

billing-bot: TKT-45821 updated: engineer assigned (dave-engineer), ops is producing corrected meter file.

kevin-finance: Once we have corrected numbers, propose the credit amount and we’ll route through finance approvals. Also include the suggested revrec note text: "Revenue reversal due to internal metering duplication bug — ticket TKT-45821".

maria-support: For the customer communication draft (tentative):
"Hi ACME — we found an internal metering bug that caused some requests to be counted twice when clients retried on auth failures. We're preparing a corrected invoice and will apply a credit of ~$291.16 (preliminary) to your account. Full reconciliation and updated invoice will follow within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption."

kevin-finance: Note on numbers: at $0.00012/token, refund for ~2,426,184 tokens = $291.14. I'll round up for goodwill to $300 if CS agrees.

sara-cs: +1 to rounding. Approve the $300 credit as a one-time goodwill. Please include SKU code CREDIT-REV-2026-03 in memo.

dave-engineer: I pushed the deduped CSV to /var/internal/billing_corrections/ACME_2026-03_deduped.csv and added a checksum. Also opened PR to change emitTokenUsage() to post-auth hook; patch will go out in next deploy cycle. Link: https://git.internal/r/infra/commit/7f3c9a

jordan-ops: I’ll apply a transient rule to exclude pre-auth token events from the billing pipeline while the patch rolls out. Will mirror corrected CSV to finance S3 with tags: revrec_note="deduped-retry-accounting-bug-2026-03", ticket="TKT-45821".

maria-support: Great — can someone add a short timeline for the customer message: root cause, remediation (code fix + dedupe + pipeline rule), and refund amount? I’ll send the update once kevin confirms the memo.

kevin-finance: Confirmed. I’ll prepare the credit memo and schedule the accounting reversal. Assigning ledger reference: LEDGER-CR-2026-0312. Will send to Sara and Maria for sign-off before issuing.

sara-cs: Thanks team. Maria — draft the message and post to the thread then I’ll send to ACME legal + billing contact. :pray:

billing-bot: TKT-45821 status: investigative -> remediation. Notifications queued.

maria-support: Draft sent in DM to @sara-cs. Closing thread here once ACME confirms.

sara-cs: Closing loop: ACME accepted $300 credit and appreciated the transparency. Closing ticket TKT-45821. :white_check_mark:
